anchor_rationale: 3B is the capability inflection between 1.5B (undersensitive to method changes — effects wash out) and 7B (too expensive to replicate 6+ times in the window · 5-10 hrs/run at 3B · fits 6 ablations + reference in ~35-60 hrs of productive time).  H200 140GB handles LoRA at all ablation ranks (8/16/32) without memory pressure.
wizard_wiring_notes: every run auto-attaches Tier 1 notebook · CIF-ideation event written BEFORE run starts (hypothesis + expected direction · WPW novelty-chain: ideation -> adoption -> measured delta vs Campaign-A 3B baseline record) · Tier 2 report at settlement carries novelty_verdict (better/worse/no-signal) · Tier 3 eligibility mechanically evaluated + verdict recorded (publication BLOCKED pending R1/R2/R3)

runs.objective_ref: Objective 2 · B · reference config · establishes the ablation-anchor point independently from Campaign-A 3B seed 1
runs.ideation_hypothesis: This is the reference configuration.  All ablations are judged relative to it.  Expected: comparable to Campaign-A A-2-3B-seed01 on the USSD slice + additional generalisation from SMS contribution.

runs.objective_ref: Objective 2 · B · ablation B1 · corpus = USSD-only (remove SMS)
runs.ideation_hypothesis: Removing SMS narrows the training domain.  Expected: narrower held-out generalisation (worse on cross-domain samples) but STRONGER performance on USSD-slice specifically.  Novelty verdict directions: better_on_ussd_only / worse_overall / no_signal.

runs.objective_ref: Objective 2 · B · ablation B2 · dedup = off (train on duplicate-heavy corpus)
runs.ideation_hypothesis: Duplicate-heavy corpus overfits to repeated prompts.  Expected: worse held-out generalisation (higher perplexity on held-out slice) than reference.  Novelty verdict directions: worse / no_signal.

runs.objective_ref: Objective 2 · B · ablation B3 · LoRA rank = 8 (lower capacity)
runs.ideation_hypothesis: Lower rank underfits the corpus.  Expected: degraded held-out vs reference.  Novelty verdict directions: worse / no_signal.

runs.objective_ref: Objective 2 · B · ablation B4 · LoRA rank = 32 (higher capacity)
runs.ideation_hypothesis: Higher rank risks overfitting on this corpus size.  Expected: diminishing returns or regression vs reference (rank-16).  Novelty verdict directions: better_marginal / no_signal / worse.

runs.objective_ref: Objective 2 · B · ablation B5 · context length = 512 (truncated context)
runs.ideation_hypothesis: Truncated context loses tail examples.  Expected: degraded evaluation on long-response tasks.  Novelty verdict directions: worse_on_long_tasks / no_signal / better_wall_clock.

runs.objective_ref: Objective 2 · B · ablation B6 · context length = 2048 (extended context)
runs.ideation_hypothesis: Extended context increases per-step cost.  Expected: marginal held-out gain at wall-clock premium.  Novelty verdict directions: better_marginal / no_signal / worse_cost_efficiency.

wall_clock_budget_hours.trim_recommendation: If B6 (ctx=2048) alone risks overrun at max estimate, drop B6 last — the context-length effect is partially observable via B5 (ctx=512) alone.

wave_honest_limits: One-at-a-time ablation design (not full factorial) — 6 ablations × 1 seed each = 6 runs · 2×2×3×3=36-run full factorial doesn't fit any 3-day window at 3B.  Trim rationale: single-seed ablations show DIRECTION of effect; a second seed at each ablation is a follow-on if the campaign window is extended.

Reference config duplicates Campaign-A A-2-3B-seed01's 3B run with USSD-only corpus vs Campaign-B REF's USSD+SMS corpus — the two 3B seeds ARE the baseline_record for ablation comparison (novelty_verdict computed against paired Campaign-A record).

CIF-ideation events must be written to Tier 1 notebook BEFORE each run's first checkpoint — invariant `test_wpw_tier1_notebook_ideation_event_precedes_first_checkpoint` chartered as follow-on if not already enforced.
B6 (ctx=2048) is the wall-clock-riskiest ablation — trim it last if the window is tight.
